problems.updated: Updated README.md to include project overview, setup and usage instructions, and CI/test helper information.
problems.fix_explanation: The original README.md was empty. Added clear setup steps, instructions to create a .venv, how to run the app, and how to run tests using the provided auto_test.py helper.
Added pytest to requirements so the test suite can be run inside the project's virtual environment.
Prevent committing local virtual environments, logs, and Python bytecode to the repository.

problems.updated: Added auto_test.py: a helper script that starts the project and runs pytest using the interpreter inside .venv, writing results to logs/test_run.log.
problems.fix_explanation: Provides a reproducible way to run the application and tests in CI and locally using the project's .venv interpreter.
